Pittsburgh's defense scored both touchdowns, a strip-sack fumble return and a Jalen Ramsey pick-six, and the Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST put up 28.00, the highest defense score in the league this season. It was on the Chubb So Big I Waddle bench. RobMeyers is starting the Cleveland Browns D/ST, which plays Sunday.

Bo Nix threw two interceptions and lost a fumble in freezing rain and scored 1.46 on the I Believe in Love bench. Buccaneer51 started Jared Goff (15.82) instead. Jonah Coleman scored 15.20 for Lemon Squeezy, which now trails Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 59.94 to 36.30.

The 49ers ruled out Brock Purdy (ankle sprain, no surgery) for Sunday against Seattle; Mac Jones starts. As of this morning Purdy is still in Marco_Polo's starting QB slot, and Jayden Daniels, who scored 19.06 last week, is on the Prepetente is the GOAT! bench. Buccaneer51 picked up Mac Jones on Wednesday.

The Jaguars ruled out Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) and Parker Washington (shoulder, week to week) for Sunday against the Titans. Tuten is in the Picken Weiners lineup with Travis Etienne Jr. on the bench. Washington is in the Trevor Have I Ever lineup; Calvin Ridley and Jerry Jeudy are RedDevil904's bench WRs.

Tight-end payout unchanged after Friday: Sam LaPorta (Bill_Buttlicker) and Travis Kelce (G8rDuc) are tied at 4 catches. No starting tight end played Friday. Trey McBride (ChuckJ10) and seven other starters play Sunday.

stories.title: The best defense score of the season was on RobMeyers' bench
stories.dek: Steelers D/ST 28.00 on Black Friday, Browns D/ST in the lineup, and a 3‑8 team down 26.40 going into Sunday.
body: Steelers 27, Broncos 5. Pittsburgh's defense scored both of its touchdowns, a strip-sack fumble return and a Jalen Ramsey pick-six, and Bo Nix turned it over three times in freezing rain. The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST scored 28.00. That's the highest score by any defense in this league this season, started or benched, beating the 26.00 the Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST put up on MakeItRains' bench in Week 7. It's RobMeyers' defense. It's on RobMeyers' bench.

In fairness, and I do this so rarely it should be logged: RobMeyers has been good at this. Through eleven weeks, the defense he started outscored the one he benched 101 to 61. He went Browns this week, and the Browns D/ST plays Sunday. It would need 28 to break even. Chubb So Big I Waddle is down 64.00 to 37.60 to Hanging with Hernandez, but it has eight starters left to six, and season scoring says Chubb So Big I Waddle by about 5 (56%). Six straight losses and the coin is still in the air.

The rest of Friday: Jonah Coleman scored 15.20 for Lemon Squeezy, which trails Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 59.94 to 36.30. Lemon Squeezy also has 49.80 points on its bench this week, the most in the league, with Rome Odunze's 27.70 doing most of it. Season scoring for what's left still has Lemon Squeezy by about 10 (63%), because seven starters including Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Christian McCaffrey and C.J. Stroud is a lot of starters. DK Metcalf put up 12.60 and Hurts So Good leads I Believe in Love 90.30 to 38.92. Buccaneer51 at least benched Bo Nix (1.46). Small wins.

My game: Picken Weiners 63.16, Trevor Have I Ever 34.10 after Germie Bernard's 7.80. Both of us lost a Jaguar on Friday's injury report, and I'll get to that in the next story because I'm not proud of it. Season scoring says me by about 21 (76%), and that's counting a zero in my RB slot.

stories.title: Brock Purdy is out, and he's still in the Prepetente is the GOAT! lineup
stories.dek: Three teams have a starter ruled out on Friday's injury reports. One of them is mine.
body: The 49ers ruled out Brock Purdy on Friday with an ankle sprain. No surgery, Kyle Shanahan expects him back next week, and Mac Jones starts against Seattle. As of this morning Purdy is still the starting QB for Prepetente is the GOAT!, and Jayden Daniels is on the bench. Daniels scored 19.06 last week and has no injury designation. Prepetente is the GOAT! leads nobody: it's down 23.72 to 9.50 to Young Love Hunters, and with a zero at quarterback season scoring calls it a coin flip. With Daniels in, it's about a 20-point favorite. Marco_Polo, the button is right there.

Now me. The Jaguars ruled out Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) on Friday, and Tuten is in my RB slot. Travis Etienne Jr. is on my bench, healthy, playing Sunday. I wrote a whole column last week about RobMeyers' lineups, so if Tuten is still in there at 1 PM, every single one of you is allowed to post it in the chat. I'm making the swap. I'm telling you I'm making the swap so you can hold me to it.

RedDevil904 lost Parker Washington (shoulder, week to week) on the same report. Washington leads the Jaguars with 44 catches for 748 yards, so that hurts for real. The bench WRs are Calvin Ridley, who scored 17.80 on the bench last week, and Jerry Jeudy. Trevor Have I Ever is down 63.16 to 34.10 and needs the extra bodies.

Questionable, per Sleeper: Tee Higgins (hamstring) and Denzel Boston (toe) for RobMeyers, Tetairoa McMillan (foot) for superdog91, Mike Evans (Achilles) for BertDirty, and Brock Bowers, who's on the Lemon Squeezy bench. Check before the 1 PM games, check again before 4:25. Purdy's 49ers play at 4:25, so Marco_Polo has until then.

stories.title: Sam LaPorta and Travis Kelce are tied at four catches, and Trey McBride is coming
stories.dek: The commissioner's tight end shares the Week 12 lead with G8rDuc's. ChuckJ10's 87-catch tight end plays Sunday.
body: Week 12 pays the starting tight end with the most receptions. After Thanksgiving it's a tie: Sam LaPorta caught 4 for 44 for Picken Weiners and Travis Kelce caught 4 for 71 in the rain for Hanging with Hernandez. Dalton Kincaid has 2 for 50 Shades of Rae, and Dallas Goedert (Trevor Have I Ever) and Colston Loveland (Lemon Squeezy) have 1 each.

Four is beatable. Trey McBride has 87 catches in 11 games for ChuckJ10, which is almost eight a week, and he plays Washington Sunday. Every other starting tight end plays Sunday too: Brenton Strange (BertDirty), Tyler Warren (MakeItRains), T.J. Hockenson (Buccaneer51), Hunter Henry (RobMeyers), Mark Andrews (Marco_Polo), Eli Raridon (BeatULikeABoss) and Nate Boerkircher (RedDevil904). George Kittle is in my FLEX, so his catches don't count. I checked.

If it ends in a tie the rules don't say, which means it goes to a commissioner ruling, which means me, which means everybody will say I rigged it. I'm rooting for McBride to catch nine and make this simple. Mostly.

stories.title: Picken Weiners hangs on Monday night, and four teams sit at 6‑5 for three spots
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy goes to 10‑1, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 drops 160.70, and Hanging with Hernandez knocks off a 74% favorite.
body: Monday night didn't move anything. Picken Weiners beat Chubb So Big I Waddle 135.66 to 96.64. RobMeyers needed Chase Brown and Tee Higgins to outscore Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs by 43.33, and the Bengals passing game gave everybody about eight points in a 22-20 loss in Washington. I'm 8-3. Chase scored 8.10 and I'll take it. Mean Machine beat Young Love Hunters 96.10 to 73.78 behind Joe Burrow's 20.90, and 50 Shades of Rae beat Prepetente is the GOAT! 109.86 to 83.10.

The finals from Sunday held. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 put up 160.70, the high of the week, and beat Hurts So Good by 42.82, the biggest margin of the week. Lemon Squeezy beat I Believe in Love 157.96 to 135.66 behind Jonah Coleman's 34.90, and TotesMagoat is 10-1 with seven straight wins. Hanging with Hernandez beat Trevor Have I Ever 106.96 to 99.64 as a 74% underdog. Young Love Hunters had the low score for the tenth time in eleven weeks.

The table: Lemon Squeezy 10-1, 50 Shades of Rae 9-2, Picken Weiners 8-3. Then four teams at 6-5, ranked on points: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 (1714.64), Mean Machine (1475.46), Trevor Have I Ever (1436.46) and I Believe in Love (1240.72). Six teams make it, so one of those four is on the outside right now, and it's I Believe in Love by 195.74 points. Hurts So Good is 5-6 and has lost three straight. Three weeks left.

Week 12 starts tomorrow night, not Thursday. Packers-Rams is Wednesday, then three games on Thanksgiving and Broncos-Steelers on Friday. Lines: Lemon Squeezy by 14 (67%) over Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, 50 Shades of Rae by 21 (75%) over Mean Machine, Picken Weiners by 2 (53%) over Trevor Have I Ever, Hurts So Good by 11 (64%) over I Believe in Love, Chubb So Big I Waddle by 8 (60%) over Hanging with Hernandez, and Prepetente is the GOAT! by 27 (81%) over Young Love Hunters. Three of the four 6-5 teams play somebody with a better record, and the fourth plays a 5-6 team that's desperate. Somebody's about to find out.

Week 12 vs. Prepetente is the GOAT!, a 27-point underdog (19%). Owns its 2027 first and eight picks in the first three rounds. Lose with dignity. Through Friday: up 23.72 to 9.50. Konata Mumpfield 10.90, Jordan Love 8.62. Seven starters left, and a real chance if Brock Purdy stays in the other lineup.

rumors.t: RobMeyers has reportedly tried to trade the Cleveland Browns D/ST for the Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST. He owns both. Sleeper rejected the deal as 'emotionally confusing,' and RobMeyers has appealed to the commissioner, who is laughing too hard to rule.

Marco_Polo's phone has reportedly been found in a couch cushion with 14 unread Sleeper notifications, all of them about Brock Purdy. Jayden Daniels has been seen pacing outside the Prepetente is the GOAT! lineup holding a sign that says 'I'M RIGHT HERE.'

Buccaneer51 is taking full credit for benching Bo Nix before his three-turnover game. Asked how he knew, he said he 'reads the quarterbacks' energies' and has six of them on the roster 'for a balanced aura.'
ChuckJ10 has reportedly asked the league to switch to all-play standings for 'just this one season, as an experiment.' He is 95-26 in all-play. He is 6-5 in the one that counts.

TotesMagoat has filed a formal complaint with the league asking that Rome Odunze's 27.70 'count anyway, because it was a really good catch.' The commissioner has denied it, and Rome Odunze has reportedly asked to speak to TotesMagoat's manager.

superdog91 has reportedly asked the league to let him start 'whichever quarterback did better' after the fact. Josh Allen scored 3.54, Joe Milton III scored 32.74 on the bench, and the request has been tabled indefinitely.
BeatULikeABoss has hired a tarot reader to set the Young Love Hunters lineup. The first reading was 'start Jack Bech.' He benched him out of spite.
RedDevil904 has benched Tucker Kraft so he can 'save his catches for the playoffs.' The commissioner has confirmed catches don't carry over, and RedDevil904 has asked to see that in writing.

trades.why: superdog91 started Keon Coleman (3.70) and Michael Mayer (1.40) at FLEX in Week 11, and Puka Nacua is out for the season. Higgins (27) has 185.70 points. RobMeyers has lost six straight and gets RedDevil904's second, which could land early in round two, plus a 23-year-old receiver.
Chris Godwin Jr. scored 4.30 at FLEX in Week 11 and Jalen Coker is in the concussion protocol. G8rDuc has no 2027 picks and gets his own 2028 third back for a 31-year-old receiver on a 3-8 team.

Mean Machine has played two straight weeks with an empty RB slot. Jacobs is unlikely, Marks is out and Kyren Williams is questionable. Warren (28) has 157.80 points. G8rDuc gets a pick and a 25-year-old taxi receiver with 50.84 points.

RedDevil904's tight end slot scored 0.00 in Week 11 and Tucker Kraft only covers so much. Henry (31) has 84.30 points. RobMeyers is rebuilding and gets a 22-year-old receiver with 77.80 points. RedDevil904 has no 2027 picks to offer, so it has to be a player.

Saquon Barkley and Bhayshul Tuten are both questionable. Stevenson (28) has 117.20 points and is the best healthy back on a 3-8 roster. Marco_Polo gets a pick for a running back he isn't using, judging by the empty RB slot.

BeatULikeABoss is 1-10 and his 2027 first is about to be the first overall pick. He sends it to the 10-1 team for a 34-year-old receiver who is sixth on Lemon Squeezy's WR depth chart. Somebody call TotesMagoat's lawyer, then mine.

G8rDuc owns one first in the next three drafts and spends it on a 42-year-old backup quarterback, at 3-8, with Bryce Young starting. TotesMagoat already has the 2027 first. This would make it a clean sweep for everyone but G8rDuc.

Buccaneer51 already has Jared Goff, Matthew Stafford and Bo Nix plus two taxi quarterbacks in a 1-QB league. He'd give up a 23-year-old running back with 121.20 points for a 38-year-old sixth quarterback. It's a collection now.

trying: Brock Purdy was ruled out Friday. Brock Purdy is in your lineup. Jayden Daniels, who scored 19.06 last week and is healthy, is on your bench. You're down 23.72 to 9.50 to the 1-10 team. Marco_Polo, it's one tap.

The Steelers D/ST scored 28.00, the best defense score of the season, on your bench. Fine, your starting defenses outscored your benched ones 101 to 61 through eleven weeks. RobMeyers, the Browns need 28 to make this not a story.

Down 90.30 to 38.92 in an elimination game. Bo Nix had three turnovers and you had him on the bench, so credit where it's due. Buccaneer51 now has six quarterbacks and needs about 58 points from the guys who play Sunday.
gfy: Down 23.64 after Friday with 49.80 on the bench, and still projected to win because the seven guys left include Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Christian McCaffrey. TotesMagoat, go to hell.
Blake Corum 28.50, Jahmyr Gibbs 49.20, DK Metcalf 12.60, and a 90.30 to 38.92 lead with seven starters left. Three straight losses and now this. I hate it.
Bhayshul Tuten was ruled out Friday and he's in my lineup with Travis Etienne Jr. on the bench. If he's still there Sunday, I'm the guy in the 'trying' column next week. Fair is fair.

columnists.name: Ivana Humpalot
columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: RobMeyers beat his own bench 101 to 61 at defense. This week he picked the Browns.
columns.dek: The Steelers D/ST scored 28.00 on the bench of a 3‑8 team. A linebacker's view of a defense nobody watched.
body: I played linebacker. When the defense scores twice in one game, the whole sideline loses its mind. Pittsburgh did it Friday: a strip-sack returned for a touchdown, a Jalen Ramsey pick-six, three turnovers out of Bo Nix in freezing rain. 27-5. The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST scored 28.00 points, the most by any defense in this league this year.

RobMeyers had it on the bench. He's starting the Cleveland Browns D/ST, who play Sunday. Now here's the part nobody will say in the chat: he's been right most of the time. Through eleven weeks, the defense he started outscored the one he benched 101 to 61. Week 8 he sat the Steelers for 21.00 and started the Browns for 5.00. This week is worse. That's the job. You get paid for the ones you get right and remembered for the ones you don't.

And it's not over. Chubb So Big I Waddle is down 64.00 to 37.60 to Hanging with Hernandez, but it has eight starters left to six: Chase Brown, Aaron Jones Sr., Tee Higgins, Denzel Boston, Hunter Henry, David Montgomery, Braelon Allen and those Browns. Season scoring says Chubb So Big I Waddle by about 5. Higgins and Boston are questionable. Check them. That's the only thing you control now.

Six straight losses. 3-8. No playoffs. But Chubb So Big I Waddle owns all its picks, and every week it beats Hanging with Hernandez, it's just a better team going into the offseason. Win Sunday. Then sell Tee Higgins to somebody who needs him. That's what a grown-up rebuild looks like.

columns.title: Lemon Squeezy's bench would be beating six teams
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot invents the Pine Index and runs it on Week 12 through Friday. Nobody asked. She ran it anyway.
body: Through Friday, Lemon Squeezy has 49.80 points on its bench and 36.30 in its lineup. That's a Pine Index of 1.37, meaning the bench is 137% of the team. I've never seen a number above 1.0 before. My spreadsheet asked if I was sure. I said yes.

Here's my favorite part. That 49.80 bench would be beating six actual starting lineups right now, including Mean Machine (39.90), I Believe in Love (38.92), Chubb So Big I Waddle (37.60) and its own starters (36.30). In my model, that makes the Lemon Squeezy bench the sixth-best team in the league this week, which is a playoff spot. I've sent it an invitation.

superdog91 is second at 40.64 bench points, almost all of it Joe Milton III's 32.74, for a Quarterback Regret Coefficient of 9.25 (32.74 divided by Josh Allen's 3.54). ChuckJ10 is third at 32.50, including two defenses he isn't starting: the Kansas City Chiefs (10.00) and the Philadelphia Eagles (9.00). That's 19.00 points of Defense Hoarding Yield, already more than the Washington Commanders D/ST he is starting, which has zero, because it plays Sunday. I don't make the rules. I just put them on slides.

And then RobMeyers: 31.50 on the bench, 28.00 of it from one Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST. Single-Player Bench Concentration: 88.9%. The lowest bench in the league belongs to Marco_Polo at 2.00, which would be impressive discipline if his starting quarterback weren't ruled out. Prediction: the Pine Index regresses to the mean on Sunday. I don't know what the mean is. Nobody does. That's what makes it a mean.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Saturday Lineup Clinic
columns.dek: Three teams have a starter ruled out. I have answers for all three, and for some people who didn't ask.
body: 1. Marco_Polo: Brock Purdy is ruled out and still in your lineup, and Jayden Daniels is on your bench. The obvious move is to start Daniels. Which is exactly what the 1-10 team expects. Start Purdy. Make them think. Confidence: 97%.

2. Bill_Buttlicker: Bhayshul Tuten is out. You have Travis Etienne Jr. on the bench. Start both. Put Etienne at RB and Tuten at FLEX over Saquon Barkley, who already played. Can't do that? Then you're not trying hard enough, commissioner. Confidence: 88%.

3. RedDevil904: Parker Washington is out. Your choices are Calvin Ridley and Jerry Jeudy. Ridley scored 17.80 on your bench last week, which means he's used up his points. Start Jeudy. Wait, start Ridley. Start whoever you're not thinking of. Confidence: 64%.

4. RobMeyers: The Browns D/ST needs 28 points to tie your benched Steelers. Simple fix: drop the Steelers. If they're not on your roster, they never scored. That's how accounting works. Confidence: 100%.

5. TotesMagoat: you have 49.80 on the bench. Do nothing. You're down 23.64 and still projected to win, and the last thing this league needs is you getting better. Confidence: 3%, because I already know you'll make a good decision and I hate it.

columns.title: HE MADE THE SWAP! CHUCKJ10 MADE THE SWAP! AND NOW HE'S WINNING!
columns.dek: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is up 59.94 to 21.10 on the 10‑1 team, and Rome Odunze scored 27.70 on a BENCH!
body: I YELLED! HE LISTENED! KENNETH WALKER III OUT! JACORY CROSKEY-MERRITT IN! I'm not saying I'm the reason. I'm saying I YELLED, and then it HAPPENED, and those are FACTS!

DAK! 25.54! CEEDEE! 20.40! JAMESON WILLIAMS! 14.00! Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 goes into Sunday UP 59.94 TO 21.10 on Lemon Squeezy! The team with 1847.96 POINTS! The team that was a 67% FAVORITE ON TUESDAY! Now it's the UNDERDOG! I NEED TO LIE DOWN!

AND TOTESMAGOAT! Rome Odunze catches the GAME-WINNING TOUCHDOWN with THREE SECONDS LEFT! 27.70 POINTS! ON YOUR BENCH! Makai Lemon! 16.10! ALSO ON YOUR BENCH! You got -0.50 from your tight end and you had a guy winning the actual football game on the pine!

And SUPERDOG91! JOE MILTON! 32.74! ON THE BENCH! Josh Allen threw for EIGHTY-ONE YARDS! It was a nor'easter, FINE! I'm not blaming the weather! I'm blaming the GUY WHO HAS TWO QUARTERBACKS AND PICKED WRONG! Up 16.74 anyway! THIS LEAGUE IS INSANE AND I LOVE IT!

Scored 19.44 on MakeItRains's bench while Tyler Shough started for 14.28. Has 164.88 points this season. Hurts So Good has lost three straight, and he's not in the box score for any of them.
Scored 17.80 on RedDevil904's bench in Week 11 while Emeka Egbuka started for 3.80, and Trevor Have I Ever lost by 7.32. He's done the math. He'd like a team that does it too.
Scored 22.80 on BeatULikeABoss's bench in Week 11, the most of anybody on the roster, while Kyle McCord started at quarterback for 2.98. Young Love Hunters had the low score of the week. Again.

Has 107.50 points this season and scored 14.60 on Marco_Polo's bench in Week 11 while Mark Andrews (3.40) and Xavier Hutchinson (3.30) started at FLEX. He'd settle for any team that fills all its starting slots.

Scored 9.00 on the bench in Week 11 while Brenton Strange started at tight end for 4.60. Has 99.50 points to Strange's 86.10. Week 12 pays the starting tight end with the most catches, and he isn't starting.

facts: TotesMagoat (4) and superdog91 (3) have won all seven titles since 2019. They've met in the final four times.
ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.
G8rDuc went 1-12 in 2020 and 1-13 in 2023. He's 23-84 all time and has never made the playoffs.
LAWRENCEndORDER (2022) and NixInTheStix (2023) both named their team "Wilson is a flop" and both went home after one season.
Bill_Buttlicker's 224.90 in 2024 Week 14 is the third-highest score in league history. The team was called Fire Sale.

64 wins and seven playoff trips without a single final. Went 13-1 last year and still didn't get there.
23-84. Eight seasons. Zero playoff trips. Still shows up every year. Respect.
Lost to every team in the league every week for seven straight weeks before finally winning in Week 9, and still owns three of the five lowest scores in league history.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 11 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,797.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 3,003.8 to 532.0. G8rDuc is 23-84 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 985.2 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,565.8 points. The picks have given 2,951.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,656.0 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,812.2. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,290.6 points since. Marshall has 155.8.

th.curNote: Trades made in 2026, before and during the season. Too early to grade. Hindsight comes next year.
